function: Channel estimation of the direct and cascaded channels of a RIS-assisted uplink, by diffusion-model denoising of the received pilots with SNR-adaptive step matching (p. 1, p. 3).
system: Uplink; BS with M=Mh x Mv UPA antennas, passive reflecting RIS with N=Nh x Nv elements, single-antenna UE; mmWave at 28 and 73 GHz (pp. 2, 4).
method: Diffusion model with DDIM sampling and a BRCNet (or U-Net) noise predictor, trained with a noise-prediction loss on simulated channels (generative, unsupervised); no fine-tuning (p. 3).
data_channel: Simulated clustered statistical channel following 3GPP TR 38.901 and [15], generated with code based on open-source SimRIS; 50,000 training, 10,000 validation, 10,000 test samples per scenario (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Four scenarios (InH, UMi; 28, 73 GHz), each with own training set and held-out test set; SNR swept -10 to 10 dB without retraining (pp. 3-4, Fig. 3).
baselines: Classical: LMMSE, DSOMP. Learned: CDRN, LCDM (CNN1, CNN2) diffusion prior, GDM guided diffusion; ablations T=200, no step-matching, CNN2/U-Net backbones (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (-10 to 10 dB) in four scenarios; number of parameters and multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) in Table I (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Table I: parameters and MACs: BRCNet 2.41M and 2.18G, U-Net 25.81M and 7.97G, CNN2 2.38M and 2.58G, CNN1 55.03K and 57.32M (p. 5).
openness: none (dataset generation code is based on open-source SimRIS, but no release or link of the authors' own code or data is stated, p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "Following [14] and [15], a clustered statistical channel model is adopted" (ref. [14] is 3GPP TR 38.901, p. 5); p. 4: "Our dataset generation code is developed based on the open-source MATLAB simulator SimRIS [15]".
q2_support: p. 4: "For each scenario, the training set consists of 50,000 channel samples"; only the SNR is varied at test time (p. 4, Fig. 3), with no unseen scenario, band, array size or number of pilots. Not met: SNR sweep and per-scenario training.
q3_support: p. 4: "the following baselines: (i) the LMMSE estimator; (ii) DSOMP [3]; (iii) CDRN [4]" and "(vi) GDM [11]", all compared on NMSE: "Proposed (BRCNet) achieves gains of 9.01 dB and 3.01 dB" over LCDM (CNN1, CNN2).
q4_support: p. 5: "Table I compares the number of parameters and the number of multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) of different networks."
q5_support: p. 4: "Our dataset generation code is developed based on the open-source MATLAB simulator SimRIS [15]". Not met: no link, DOI or release statement for the authors' own code or data, and the data are simulated, not a public dataset.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match the work. Table I and Fig. 3 were read from the page image (p. 5). q1 relies on the citation of TR 38.901 [14] together with SimRIS [15] (InH and UMi at 28 and 73 GHz); the paper does not itself state that SimRIS is built on 38.901, so the reviewer should confirm. Step matching makes the same trained model work across SNRs, which is an SNR sweep and does not count for q2.
